correctness.rationale: The normalized Hopf measure, Jacobi differential equation and exact orthogonality yield an orthonormal bandlimited eigenbasis. On the single torus each weight block is one row with entries explicitly evaluated at zero, so positive eigenvalues are sums of squared coefficients; j=0 makes every diamond weight present. The j=0 binomial coefficient proves lambda >= L/2^(L-1), and all equality cases are explicitly identified. The Moore–Penrose formula and exact inverse norm follow blockwise. Independent Laurent-polynomial addition-kernel coefficients agree with the Jacobi formula for every frequency through cutoff 9; the written analytic proof covers all cutoffs.

value.rationale: Restriction from finite spherical-harmonic bands to the canonical minimal Clifford torus is a natural and motivated measurement problem. Exact image, full ambiguity, reconstruction, complete positive spectrum, and sharp exponentially diverging optimal inverse amplification quantify an otherwise nontransparent distinction between representability and stable observability. The all-band sharp bound and equality modes are not a generic rank statement, arbitrary finite example or trivial normalization check.
